description: Compare two versions of a base locale and report which translations went stale. A base string edited without its translations being edited leaves every locale confidently wrong, nothing in the translation file marks it, and the diff is the only place it is visible. Also reports a removed key, where anything still referencing it shows the key in the interface; translations still carrying a removed key; and, per locale, how many of the new keys are outstanding. Pay 170000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The later base locale. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

before.description: The earlier base locale. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

translations.description: The translations to judge against the change. Omitting them is reported as not having determined which locales are stale, which is the question this product exists for.

messages.description: That locale’s messages. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

name: locale_file_diff

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

unchanged.description: True only when the two base versions were identical and nothing was left undetermined.
